source.title: TNoodle 0.9.0
source.content:
TNoodle-WCA-0.9.0 is now available from [https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles)

This following major changes have been made since TNoodle 0.8.4:

- Initialization for 4x4x4 scrambles is significantly faster.
- Alternating lines of long scrambles are now highlighted, for easier reading.
<!--break-->

Please remember that official competitions must always use the current version of the official scramble program. This is always available from: [https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/)

translation.title: TNoodle 0.9.0 发布
translation.content:
TNoodle-WCA-0.9.0 现已可从[https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles)获取。

与 TNoodle 0.8.4 相比，主要改动如下：

- 四阶打乱生成器的初始化速度大幅加快。
- 较长打乱的相邻行采用交替高亮，方便阅读。

<!--break-->

请记住，官方比赛必须始终使用当前有效版本的官方打乱程序。最新版可从以下页面获取：[https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/)
